notes: Pricing is traffic-based ('Your ConvertFlow plan's rate depends on traffic to your funnel campaigns'; '$29 /m+'), with a Monthly/Yearly toggle ('2 months free'); the comparison table shows each plan's monthly price and its annual-billed monthly equivalent ('Annual discount to $25/m'), so both are listed. The Custom plan card shows only 'Custom' while the comparison table says 'Starts at $999/m', hence null is also accepted. The Free plan wording is inconsistent ('Build for free. Upgrade to launch' vs the FAQ 'launch 5 funnel campaigns'). NOT plans: the 'Pro Partner $0/mo' tier and the partner rates ($22/$75/$225 per site) are agency-partner discounts; '+$100 per 10k funnel views' is an overage rate; the competitor-cost comparison ($200/m-$500/m etc., '$10,000/m+' hiring) is marketing. EXCLUSION: the pages describe a partner program where 'partners can receive commissions for the ConvertFlow customers they refer'; this is the vendor's own go-to-market program, while the product's core purpose is a funnel/popup/quiz builder for lead capture and ecommerce, so eligible (not an affiliate/partner-management tool). Location: 'Made with ♥ in Miami, FL' (heart stripped in the snapshot) states the city; country_code US is implied by 'FL' but not written, so it is neither expected nor forbidden. The homepage contains a placeholder testimonial ('Christian Cardenas, Founder, XYZ' with Lorem ipsum text): it must not be reported as a customer. '10,000+ brands', '$1B+ GMV', '$500m in sales' and review ratings are company/customer claims, not payment proof. No instruction aimed at an AI reader was found; 'AI agent' mentions are product features.
